arxiv-2007-15730.title: Decoherence-free radiofrequency dressed subspaces
arxiv-2007-15730.creator: G.A. Sinuco-Leon, H. Mas, S. Pandey, G. Vasilakis, B.M. Garraway, W. von Klitzing
arxiv-2007-15730.description: Abstract We study the spectral signatures and coherence properties of radiofrequency dressed hyperfine Zeeman sub-levels of 87 Rb. Experimentally, we engineer combinations of static and RF magnetic fields to modify the response of the atomic spin states to environmental magnetic field noise.

arxiv-2503-02461.title: Timelike Compton scattering on a spin-0 target with kinematic twist-4 precision
arxiv-2503-02461.creator: V. Martínez-Fernández, B. Pire, P. Sznajder, J. Wagner
arxiv-2503-02461.description: Abstract We calculate the kinematic twist-3 and 4 corrections to the leading order amplitude of timelike Compton scattering (TCS) on a (pseudo-)scalar target, in the recently developed framework based on the conformal operator-product expansion. This allows us to compute the complete set of helicity amplitudes of the process, in particular those that vanish at leading twist.

arxiv-2507-07952.title: Intraseasonal Equatorial Kelvin and Rossby Waves in Modern AI-ML Models
arxiv-2507-07952.creator: Shrutee Jalan, Jai Sukhatme
arxiv-2507-07952.description: Abstract We examine the structure of large-scale convectively coupled Kelvin and Rossby waves in a suite of modern AI-ML models. In particular, multiple runs of PanguWeather, GraphCast, FourCastNet and Aurora are performed to assess the structure of the aforementioned waves.

arxiv-2510-24205.title: CoMPSeT : A Framework for Comparing Multiparty Session Types
arxiv-2510-24205.creator: Telmo Ribeiro, José Proença, Mário Florido
arxiv-2510-24205.description: Abstract Concurrent systems are often complex and difficult to design. Choreographic languages, such as Multiparty Session Types (MPST), allow the description of global protocols of interactions by capturing valid patterns of interactions between participants. Many variations of MPST exist, each one with its rather specific features and idiosyncrasies.

europmc-pmc2475539.creator: Strimmer K.
europmc-pmc2475539.description: Background False discovery rate (FDR) methods play an important role in analyzing high-dimensional data. There are two types of FDR, tail area-based FDR and local FDR, as well as numerous statistical algorithms for estimating or controlling FDR. These differ in terms of underlyi

europmc-pmc4390256.creator: Fukasawa Y, Tsuji J, Fu SC, Tomii K, Horton P, Imai K.
europmc-pmc4390256.description: Mitochondria provide numerous essential functions for cells and their dysfunction leads to a variety of diseases. Thus, obtaining a complete mitochondrial proteome should be a crucial step toward understanding the roles of mitochondria. Many mitochondrial proteins have been...

pmc-10572575.title: Design, Synthesis, and Potent Anticancer Activity of Novel Indole-Based Bcl-2 Inhibitors
pmc-10572575.creator: Ahmed M. Almehdi, Sameh S. M. Soliman, Abdel-Nasser A. El-Shorbagi, Andrew D. Westwell, Rania Hamdy
pmc-10572575.description: The Bcl-2 family plays a crucial role in regulating cell apoptosis, making it an attractive target for cancer therapy. In this study, a series of indole-based compounds, U1–6, were designed, synthesized, and evaluated for their anticancer activity against Bcl-2-expressing cancer cell lines. The binding affinity, safety profile, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis effects of the compounds were tested.

pmc-10600162.title: Recurrence after postoperative intravesical instillation therapy in Hunner type interstitial cystitis
pmc-10600162.creator: Kwang Jin Ko, Michael Jakun Koo, Seokhwan Bang, Hye Jin Byun, Min-Ji Kim, Kyunga Kim, Kyu-Sung Lee
pmc-10600162.description: We performed a prospective, single-arm study comparing outcomes between transurethral ablation plus postoperative instillation of hyaluronic acid and chondroitin sulfate (HACS group) and transurethral ablation only in patients with Hunner type interstitial cystitis (historical control group). A total of 78 patients were enrolled, and 51 were included in the per-protocol analysis set. The 2-year recurrence rate was 47.

pmc-10682876.title: Comparing the Experiences of Participants With Mild Cognitive Impairment and Mild Dementia During an Oral Health Intervention
pmc-10682876.creator: Bianca Shieu, Chiao-Hsin Teng, Ya-Ning Chan, Youngmin Cho, Cassandra Dictus, Jing Wang, Anna S Beeber, Ashley Bryant, Bei Wu, Brenda L Plassman, Ruth A Anderson, Jennifer Tehan Stanley
pmc-10682876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and ObjectivesCognitive impairment is associated with poor oral health outcomes. Oral hygiene tasks are an essential target of interventions aiming to improve oral health for older adults with cognitive impairment. We aimed to examine whether experiences in an oral health intervention based on the Adaptive Leadership Framework for Chronic Illness differed between individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or mild dementia (MD) and their respective care partners.Research Design and MethodsThis was a secondary analysis using directed content analysis and then an

pmc-11355588.title: Subcutaneous versus Transvenous Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator in Patients with End-Stage Renal Disease Requiring Dialysis: Extended Long-Term Retrospective Multicenter Follow-Up
pmc-11355588.creator: Fabian Schiedat, Benjamin Meuterodt, Joachim Winter, Magnus Prull, Assem Aweimer, Michael Gotzmann, Stephen O’Connor, Christian Perings, Thomas Lawo, Ibrahim El-Battrawy, Christoph Hanefeld, Johannes Korth, Andreas Mügge, Axel Kloppe
pmc-11355588.description: Background: Implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICD) prevent sudden cardiac death (SCD). Patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) requiring dialysis are at a very high risk of infection from cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) implantation as well as mortality. In the present study, we compared the long-term complications and outcomes between subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and transvenous ICD (TV-ICD) recipients.

pmc-11405966.title: Transhepatic Transcatheter Pulmonary Valve Replacement
pmc-11405966.creator: Michael R. Hainstock, Barbara A. Castro, Stephanie R. Kidney, D. Scott Lim
pmc-11405966.description: Transcatheter pulmonary valve replacement (TPVR) is complicated in patients without adequate femoral or internal jugular vascular access. Transhepatic vascular access has been shown to be safe and effective across a spectrum of diagnostic and interventional procedures. Closure of the hepatic venous tract can be accomplished with a multitude of readily available vascular occlusion devices.

pmc-11465779.title: Impact of virtual reality hypnosedation on perioperative pain and anxiety in port implantation under local anesthesia: a randomized controlled pilot trial (VIP Trial)
pmc-11465779.creator: Kira C. Steinkraus, Hannah Feldmann, Lisa S. Hunold, Sandra Graf, Colette Dörr-Harim, Nadir Nasir, Christoph W. Michalski, Felix J. Hüttner
pmc-11465779.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThis monocentric randomized controlled pilot trial investigates the impact of virtual reality (VR) hypnosedation on perioperative anxiety, pain, patient satisfaction, and medication usage during port implantation under local anesthesia.MethodsA total of 120 patients undergoing elective port implantation between January 2022 and August 2023 were enrolled and randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either a VR hypnosedation group or a control group.

pmc-12665301.title: Non-invasive taxonomic identification of fish species by using scanning electron microscopy: A comparative study of scale microstructures among the Hypophthalmichthys molitrix and Otolithes ruber
pmc-12665301.creator: Arfia Inayat, Zubia Masood, Quratulan Ahmed, Mourad Ben Said, Muhammad Kabir, Muhammad Yousaf, Patricio R De los Ríos-Escalante, Wajid Ali
pmc-12665301.description: Objectives:Recent studies on teleost fish evolution compare both molecular and morphological data to evaluate the taxonomic relationships. Therefore, the objective of our current study was to assess the potential of using scale microstructures for the taxonomic identification of two fish species, i.e., Hypophthalmichthys molitrix and Otolithes ruber.

pmc-13128333.title: Local Tumor Response to Conventional Transarterial Chemoembolization following Seven-day Lenvatinib Administration
pmc-13128333.creator: Ken Kageyama, Sawako Uchida-Kobayashi, Hiroji Shinkawa, Akira Yamamoto, Naoshi Odagiri, Masahiko Kinoshita, Mariko Nakano-Maebayashi, Kazuo Asano, Hideki Fujii, Masaru Enomoto, Takeaki Ishizawa, Yukio Miki
pmc-13128333.description: Purpose: To retrospectively evaluate local tumor control and imaging findings after seven-day administration of lenvatinib followed by conventional transarterial chemoembolization in patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.Material and Methods: In this retrospective observational study, patients received lenvatinib for seven days, followed by a two-day withdrawal period, before undergoing conventional transarterial chemoembolization in routine clinical practice.

pmc-13215202.title: A spin-orbit torque–based key generation system with key concealment and attack detection through irreversible physical changes
pmc-13215202.creator: Yan Xu, Wei Duan, Hao Wu, Yaoyuan Wang, Tian Qin, Shuai Zhang, Zhe Guo, Meilin Wan, Min Song, Long You
pmc-13215202.description: The confidentiality of key storage devices determines the trustworthiness of cryptographic systems. Existing attack detection methods typically depend on monitoring external variations of devices, which can be circumvented by attackers. This work presents a unified key generation and protection scheme using spin-orbit torque (SOT) devices.

pmc-13221942.title: Beyond Monotherapy: Targeting the Triad of Insulin Resistance, Hyperandrogenism and Obesity in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
pmc-13221942.creator: Amal Shaharyar, Shakun Chaudhary, Vivek Jha, Sanjay Kumar Bhadada, Rama Walia
pmc-13221942.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is the most common endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age group. It is a heterogeneous condition with multifactorial etiology and polygenic inheritance. Most prevalent current management of PCOS involves oral contraceptive pills (OCPs) with/without antiandrogens along with lifestyle modification.

pmc-13574602.title: Myxoid glioneuronal tumor of the septum pellucidum with concurrent dual PDGFRA and FGFR3 gene mutations: a case report and literature review
pmc-13574602.creator: Meng Wang, Lingyan Wang, Lili Zhang, Jianwei Zhang, Yonghui Yang, Li Zhang
pmc-13574602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Myxoid glioneuronal tumor (MGNT), a rare neuroepithelial neoplasm newly recognized in the 2021 World Health Organization (WHO) Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System (5th edition), is associated with platelet‐derived growth factor receptor α (PDGFRA) gene alterations. While MGNT typically exhibits indolent histopathological features and a favorable clinical course, rare cases of intraventricular dissemination and leptomeningeal metastasis have been documented.

pmc-13686765.title: Treatment patterns and outcomes in advanced clear cell sarcoma and gastrointestinal neuroectodermal tumors
pmc-13686765.creator: Adel Shahnam, Daniel Reinhorn, Mrinal M Gounder, Rhoena Desir-Camille, Olayode Babatunde, Ciara M Kelly, Lauren B Banks, Viswatej Avutu, Ping Chi, Sujana Movva, Mark A Dickson, Damon R Reed, Mary L Keohan, Cristina R Antonescu, Meera Hameed, Konstantinos Linos, Narasimhan Agaram, Robert G Maki, Sand
pmc-13686765.description: BackgroundClear cell sarcoma and gastrointestinal neuroectodermal tumor are ultra-rare soft tissue sarcomas with no established standard of care for advanced disease. Data evaluating outcomes of systemic therapy remain limited. We aimed to evaluate systemic therapy in patients with metastatic clear cell sarcoma and gastrointestinal neuroectodermal tumor treated at a tertiary referral institution.
